JORGE LUIS PACHECO TRIO: “Live from Havana”

Sponsored by Bonnie Rattner

Hailing from Havana, Cuba, Jorge Luis Pacheco is one of the leading pianists and composers of the new generation of jazz in Cuba. Winner of the Montreux Jazz Piano Solo Competition in Switzerland, Pacheco is a fiery young pianist with “flying hands.” His music is a confluence of Cuban jazz and Afro-Cuban music, American jazz, and classical music with a measure of contemporary pop and soul.

 

Pacheco was the 2017 winner of the JoJAzz Award in Havana and won the Best Solo and Performance Award in the “Made in New York” Jazz Competition in New York City the same year with his original composition “Con el Pache me Voy.” Pacheco has a master’s degree in composition from the Instituto Superior de Arte de La Habana.

 

He has collaborated with Wynton Marsalis and the JLCO, Arturo O’Farrill, and Lenny White, as well as leading Cuban artists such as Alexander Abreu, Isaac Delgado, Gonzalo Rubalcaba, Amadito Valdés and Teté Caturla (Buena Vista Social Club); among others. Pacheco is a passionate, extravagant, and electrifying entertainer on stage and captivates audiences with his heartfelt performances and electric energy.

Jorge Luis Pacheco – Piano;  Gerson Lazo-Quiroga – Bass;  Reinier Mendoza – Drums

KAT EDMONSON - HAVE YOUR MERRY CHRISTMAS WITH ME

Sponsored byDave Dickson & Marla Wong

Vocalist Kat Edmonson brings her sparkling holiday celebration, blending jazz, cabaret, and vintage pop into an afternoon of timeless Christmas favorites and original gems. Known for her warmth, wit, and crystalline vocals, Kat creates a festive experience that’s both sophisticated and joyful. Her latest album, Have Your Merry Christmas With Me drops November 6 and plays like the soundtrack to a classic romantic comedy—lush, witty, soulful, and filled with longing, flirtation, and holiday warmth. Her prior holiday album Holiday Swingin’! A Kat Edmonson Christmas Vol. 1 was named one of the New York Times’ “13 Albums That Revisit (and Redefine!) Holiday Classics.”

Kat Edmonson is an award‑winning songwriter and singer “with an equal foothold in jazz, cabaret and vintage cosmopolitan pop” (The New York Times). Raised on early‑to‑mid‑century music and film, she blends nostalgic charm with a modern sensibility. Beyond her holiday work, Kat’s Billboard‑topping Dreamers Do inspired a 66‑episode livestream during the pandemic. Honored by the Songwriters Hall of Fame, she has written more than 40 songs, including “Lucky,” featured in Coca‑Cola’s 2014 Winter Olympics campaign, and has appeared on Austin City Limits, Tiny Desk Concerts, A Prairie Home Companion, and The Tonight Show.
